title: Dormant-crate activation — plugin-host models + xva/replog seam (arch item D)
description: FORWARD SPEC (tail — not yet landed). The plugin-host ModelRegistry is wired into the ProductEngine dispatch path so a registered plugin model prices through the same engine registry as native products, and celnet-xva + celnet-replog are either reached via an RPC seam or explicitly recorded as deferred in docs/INTERFACES.md (no silently dormant crate). The roll-up stays non-active until D ships. This is the frozen-contract acceptance for the deliverable 'dormant-crate-activation'.

assertions.statement: The plugin-host ModelRegistry is wired into the ProductEngine dispatch path: a plugin-provided model resolves through celnet_plugin_host::registry::ModelRegistry and is priced as a ProductEngine, so a registered plugin model goes through the same engine registry as native products. (Forward target — the dispatch→ModelRegistry edge does not yet exist on main.)
celnet_plugin_host::registry::ModelRegistry is the host-side registry that instantiates plugin models behind the celnet_plugin_api::registry::ModelRegistry abstraction for hot-path routing.

celnet-xva and celnet-replog are either reachable from the server via an RPC seam, or their non-activation is explicitly recorded as deferred in docs/INTERFACES.md — no crate is left silently dormant.
